const sql = [
  "WITH",
  "timeline AS (",
  "  SELECT",
  "    h.source_key AS opportunity_id,",
  "    COALESCE(NULLIF(h.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_id', ''), NULLIF(h.payload_json->>'pipelineId', ''), 'Unknown') AS pipeline,",
  "    COALESCE(NULLIF(h.dimensions_json->>'pipeline_stage_id', ''), NULLIF(h.payload_json->>'pipelineStageId', ''), 'Unknown') AS stage,",
  "    COALESCE(NULLIF(h.payload_json->>'createdAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(h.dimensions_json->>'source_created_at', '')::timestamptz, NOW()) AS stage_entered_at,",
  "    COALESCE(NULLIF(h.payload_json->>'lastStatusChangeAt', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(h.payload_json->>'updatedAt', '')::timestamptz, NOW()) AS stage_exited_at",
  "  FROM report_raw_ghl_pipeline_history h",
  "  WHERE h.source_system = 'ghl' AND h.payload_json IS NOT NULL",
  "),",
  "durations AS (",
  "  SELECT",
  "    opportunity_id, pipeline, stage, stage_entered_at, stage_exited_at,",
  "    COALESCE(LEAD(stage_entered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunity_id ORDER BY stage_entered_at), stage_exited_at) AS next_stage_entered_at,",
  "    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(LEAD(stage_entered_at) OVER (PARTITION BY opportunity_id ORDER BY stage_entered_at), stage_exited_at) - stage_entered_at)) / 86400.0 AS days_in_stage",
  "  FROM timeline",
  "),",
  "velocity AS (",
  "  SELECT pipeline, stage,",
  "    COUNT(*)::int AS opp_count,",
  "    ROUND(AVG(days_in_stage), 2)::numeric AS avg_days_in_stage,",
  "    FLOOR(MIN(days_in_stage))::int AS min_days,",
  "    CEIL(MAX(days_in_stage))::int AS max_days,",
  "    ROUND(AVG(days_in_stage), 2)::numeric AS median_days_approx,",
  "    SUM(CASE WHEN days_in_stage >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS total_transitions",
  "  FROM durations WHERE days_in_stage IS NOT NULL AND days_in_stage >= 0",
  "  GROUP BY pipeline, stage",
  "),",
  "upsert_vel AS (",
  "  INSERT INTO report_stage_velocity_summary (pipeline, stage, opp_count, avg_days_in_stage, min_days, max_days, median_days, total_transitions, metadata, computed_at)",
  "  SELECT pipeline, stage, opp_count, avg_days_in_stage, min_days, max_days, median_days_approx, total_transitions,",
  "    jsonb_build_object('computed_from', 'pipeline_history'), NOW()",
  "  FROM velocity",
  "  ON CONFLICT (pipeline, stage) DO UPDATE SET",
  "    opp_count = EXCLUDED.opp_count, avg_days_in_stage = EXCLUDED.avg_days_in_stage,",
  "    min_days = EXCLUDED.min_days, max_days = EXCLUDED.max_days,",
  "    median_days = EXCLUDED.median_days, total_transitions = EXCLUDED.total_transitions,",
  "    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, computed_at = NOW()",
  "  RETURNING id",
  "),",
  "upsert_tl AS (",
  "  INSERT INTO report_opp_stage_timeline (opportunity_id, pipeline, stage, entered_at, exited_at, days_in_stage, is_final, metadata)",
  "  SELECT opportunity_id, pipeline, stage, stage_entered_at, COALESCE(next_stage_entered_at, stage_exited_at),",
  "    ROUND(days_in_stage, 2), next_stage_entered_at IS NULL, jsonb_build_object('source', 'pipeline_history')",
  "  FROM durations WHERE days_in_stage IS NOT NULL",
  "  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id",
  "),",
  "stage_list AS (",
  "  SELECT pipeline, json_agg(json_build_object(",
  "    'stage', stage, 'avg_days', avg_days_in_stage, 'opp_count', opp_count",
  "  ) ORDER BY avg_days_in_stage DESC) AS stages",
  "  FROM velocity GROUP BY pipeline",
  ")",
  "SELECT json_build_object(",
  "  'stage_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM velocity),",
  "  'vel_inserts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upsert_vel),",
  "  'tl_inserts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM upsert_tl),",
  "  'pipelines', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('pipeline', pipeline, 'stages', stages)) FROM stage_list)",
  ") AS result;"
].join("\n");
return [{ json: { sql } }];
return [{ json: { ok: true, workflow: 'LT - Report Pipeline Velocity', status: 'completed' } }];
